data.name: Aquamarina Beach Hotel Cancun
data.address: Blvd. Kukulcan Km 3.5, Kukulcan Boulevard, Zona Hotelera, 77500 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Set on the Caribbean coast, this upmarket beachfront hotel is 9 km from Interactive Aquarium Cancun and 26 km from MUSA underwater art museum.
The modern rooms and suites offer Wi-Fi (fee), satellite TV and balconies, as well as air-conditioning and safes. Suites add kitchenettes and seating areas with sofabeds. Room service is available.
The hotel offers all-inclusive and a la carte dining options, with both provided at a breakfast buffet and 2 restaurants including a poolside gazebo. There's also a lobby bar, a private beach and an outdoor pool with a swim-up bar. Activities such as mini-golf and evening entertainment are available.
